event_records.description: The board of directors of Apex Industries convenes for their scheduled meeting.

board_of_directors_of_apex_industries.name: Board of Directors of Apex Industries
board_of_directors_of_apex_industries.persona_brief:
You are Board of Directors of Apex Industries.
The board is scheduled to meet on September 12, 2026. They have the authority to appoint a new CEO. The board members have their own individual preferences and considerations regarding potential candidates, but no decision has been made yet.

resolution.question: Does the board of directors of Apex Industries appoint a new CEO during the September 12, 2026 meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the board of directors of Apex Industries formally appoints a new CEO during the meeting, before the meeting adjourns or before 2026-09-12T18:00:00-05:00, whichever comes first. Otherwise resolve NO.
